description_en: Executes the callback step in the OIDC logon flow by submitting the code and state query parameters via a GET request, and returns the accessToken, tokenType, and expiresIn fields in the response data
description_zh: OIDC 登录流程中的 Callback 步骤，以 GET 方式提交回调携带的 code 与 state 两个查询参数，响应的 data 返回 accessToken、tokenType 与 expiresIn 三个字段
kebab_example: aliyun apig handle-oidc-callback --code code-xxxxxxxx --state state-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: HandleOidcCallback

parameters.help_en: The code parameter carried in the OIDC callback request
parameters.help_zh: OIDC 回调请求携带的 code 参数
parameters.name: code

parameters.help_en: The state parameter carried in the OIDC callback request
parameters.help_zh: OIDC 回调请求携带的 state 参数
parameters.name: state

accessToken.description_en: The access token returned for the current OIDC logon. The API definition marks this field as sensitive
accessToken.description_zh: 本次 OIDC 登录返回的 Access Token。接口定义将该字段标记为敏感字段

expiresIn.description_en: The validity period value of the access token. The unit is not specified in the API definition
expiresIn.description_zh: 访问令牌有效期相关的数值（expiresIn，int64）；单位未在接口定义中声明

tokenType.description_en: The type identifier of the access token. The valid values are not specified in the API definition
tokenType.description_zh: 访问令牌的类型标识（tokenType）；取值集合未在接口定义中声明
